test_title: SSC MTS Previous Year Paper (Held on: 18 July 2022 Shift 3)
subject: general
question:
Select the option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words.

Incapable of making mistakes or being wrong
solution:
The correct option that can be used as a one-word substitute for the given group of words is "**infallible**."

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The word "**infallible**" means **incapable of making mistakes or being wrong**. Therefore, it accurately reflects the meaning of the given group of words.
 
• The other options do not accurately reflect the meaning of the given group of words.
 
• A **"fatalist**" is someone who believes that events are predetermined and inevitable, a "**fanatic**" is someone who is excessively enthusiastic or devoted to a particular cause or belief, and a **"cynic**" is someone who believes that people are motivated purely by self-interest.
